review_notes: I read the whole file and checked its simp interface. The three `@[scoped simp]` lemmas (`divP_apply`, `ofRes_apply`, `modP_apply`) are pointwise evaluation lemmas. Each rewrites a definition applied to an index into a plain arithmetic expression, and the right-hand side is smaller, so I see no cycle or competing rule. They are used by the `simp`/`simp only` calls in `decomp`, `divP_add`, `modP_add`, `le_and_dvd_iff` and `sub_ofRes_modP`. The `rfl` unfolding lemmas `bvec_def` and `Ψ_def` are correctly left out of the simp set, because tagging them would expand the definitions everywhere. The `hp`-dependent lemmas (`divP_add`, `modP_add`, `coeff_Ψ`) take a hypothesis that simp would have to discharge, and they are applied explicitly with `rw`, so I did not recommend tagging them. I did not run Lean, so I cannot rule out a problem that only shows up when the simplifier runs. I found no concrete expression whose normal form is wrong or missing, so I report no finding.
